categories.name: Location
categories.definition: Geographical entities such as countries, cities, bodies of water, mountains, and addresses.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: Groups, institutions, companies, teams, government bodies, and political parties.

categories.name: Creative Work

categories.name: Event
categories.definition: Named historical events, battles, wars, tournaments, festivals, and competitions.

categories.definition: Taxonomic families, animal species, proteins, genes, and other biological molecules.

categories.definition: Medical conditions, disorders, and syndromes.

categories.name: Language

categories.name: Religion

categories.name: Award

categories.name: Currency
